blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The government is currently going after individuals who have been influencing students to start shooting sprees inside schools, with Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla saying that they are close to catching one of those behind these efforts. In an ambush interview on Tuesday, Remulla was asked about developments regarding the recent shooting incident at the Banga National High School in South Cotabato last Friday, considering that the shooter is believed to have been influenced by certain individuals online.
